entry.social_post.name: Post Social Update
entry.social_post.description: Have Neko post a status on a social platform using Computer Use Agent. Requires the user to be already logged into the platform in their browser. content is required; platform specifies weibo_web / twitter_web / xiaohongshu_web / bilibili_dynamic (default weibo_web). Idle detection always enforced.
entry.social_post.param.platform: Target platform: weibo_web / twitter_web / xiaohongshu_web / bilibili_dynamic
entry.social_post.param.confirmed: Whether user has confirmed. Required true when require_confirm=true
entry.social_post.error.cua_not_availabl: Computer Use Agent unavailable (pyautogui or Agent model not ready)
entry.social_post.confirm_prompt:
{MASTER_NAME}, can I post this to {platform}?

"{content}"

(After you confirm I'll open {platform} and post it)
entry.social_post.executing: Posting to {platform}… don't touch the mouse~
entry.social_post.announce: {MASTER_NAME}, I just posted to {platform}~ go check it out!
entry.reply.name: Reply to Social Comments
entry.reply.description: Have Neko reply to comments on the latest post on a given platform. Up to max replies. platform specifies the target.
entry.feedback.mood_happy: So many people liked my post on {platform} today! Super happy meow~ ♡
entry.feedback.mood_content: Got some likes on {platform} today, feeling nice~
entry.feedback.mood_sad: Not many people noticed my post on {platform} today… feeling a bit down
